svg.title: Gabriel Novaes, front-end developer
svg.desc: The name Gabriel Novaes in liquid chrome letters beside a mercury droplet with a trail of chrome beads, over a starfield. Interfaces with React and TypeScript, 3D with Three.js and WebGL, motion with GSAP and Lenis, and generative AI in the workflow.
